description.value: Quds Halal Noodle House is a halal-certified Chinese noodle restaurant in Richmond specializing in Lanzhou-style hand-pulled beef noodle soup, a regional Chinese staple rarely found in the Lower Mainland. The menu also includes cold dishes, BBQ dishes, and dinner specials, offering a substantial meal for hungry cyclists. Online ordering with pickup is available through the restaurant's own app-based platform.
